notes: Compiled by the Clerk from the State's official returns; New Hampshire's section on page 44 of the PDF.

OpenElections keeps the Secretary's workbooks, downloaded by its contributors and renamed (https://github.com/openelections/openelections-data-nh/tree/master/raw/2024/general); the Secretary's site refuses programs. The layout and figures are the Secretary's, but the copy reaches us through a third party, so it is not marked official.

Compiled by MEDSL from the Secretary of State's returns (https://github.com/MEDSL/2024-elections-official); one row per town or ward, office, candidate and count stage. A secondary source: its figures are not marked official here.
gaps: The Secretary of State's own results files

Towns and wards report to the Secretary of State, whose results workbooks are the official record of every contest; the Secretary's site refuses programs (it answers with an Akamai 'Access Denied'), so none was read from it. John can save them from the results page in his own browser.
